units.source_text: “在这里，我暂且称这位朋友为K。

en.t: Here, for the time being, I will call this friend K.

units.source_text: 我和这位K从小就很要好。

en.t: K and I had been very close since childhood.

units.source_text: 这么一说，不用解释你也明白吧，我们俩是同乡。

en.t: When I say that, you will understand without further explanation that the two of us came from the same hometown.

units.source_text: K是信奉真宗的和尚之子，但他不是长子，是次子。

en.t: K was the son of a Shinshu priest, but he was not the eldest son; he was the second son.

units.source_text: 因此K被送到某个医生家做了养子。

en.t: For that reason, K was sent to a certain doctor's family as an adopted son.

units.source_text: 在我的故乡，本愿寺派的势力很大，所以真宗派和尚要比一般人生活优裕一些。

en.t: In my hometown, the Honganji sect had great influence, so Shinshu priests lived somewhat more comfortably than ordinary people.

units.source_text: 举例来说，如果和尚的女儿到了出嫁年龄，施主们便会商量着把她嫁到某个体面人家去。

en.t: For example, if a priest's daughter reached marriageable age, the parishioners would discuss it and arrange for her to marry into some respectable family.

units.source_text: 当然花费是不会让和尚掏腰包的。

en.t: Of course, the priest himself would not be expected to pay the expenses.

units.source_text: 从这种意义上说，信奉真宗的和尚大体是有福气的。

en.t: In that sense, Shinshu priests were generally fortunate.

units.source_text: K的亲生父母家生活也很宽裕，然而是否有能力把次子送到东京去上学，便不得而知了。

en.t: K's birth family was also comfortably off, but I do not know whether they had enough means to send their second son to Tokyo for his studies.

units.source_text: 抑或是由于能够被送出去学习，才谈成养子这事的，这个我也不大清楚。

en.t: Nor do I really know whether the adoption was arranged precisely because it would make it possible for him to be sent away to study.

units.source_text: 总之，K到医生家当了养子，还是我们上中学时的事情。

en.t: In any case, K became the adopted son of a doctor's family while we were still in middle school.

units.source_text: 至今我还记得很清楚，老师在教室点名时，我突然听到K改了姓，大吃一惊。

en.t: I still remember it clearly: when the teacher called the roll in the classroom, I was startled to hear that K's surname had suddenly changed.
